node_update_repair.cause: Normal Node heartbeats invalidated the preflight resourceVersion; API server rejected the stale merge patch with Conflict.
node_update_repair.repair: Read each Node immediately before metadata patch; verify original UID and ownership on each attempt; retry only native API Conflict at most three times.
node_update_repair.boundary: Server dry-run executes admission but never persists Node changes; receipt capacity is a prior input, not a current disk qualification.
